data_card.measured: Pressure traces at the valve and along a laboratory pipeline after valve closure, with vapour cavities forming and collapsing (Bergant & Simpson 1999).
data_card.method: Pressure transducers on a laboratory pipeline rig, as described in the paper; the data are to be obtained from the authors.
data_card.uncertainty: Not yet stated: the value in reference.uncertainty is a placeholder until the published gauge or survey error is recorded.
known_issues: Journal-only data: no open licence found yet.
data_card.exercises: Wave speed, friction damping of the pressure wave, and the column-separation model (cavity formation and the secondary peaks when cavities collapse).
data_card.cannot_tell: Matching the first Joukowsky peak shows the wave speed is right, not that the cavity model is; only the timing and size of the later peaks test that.

title: Bergant slow valve closure with column separation
description: Laboratory water-hammer with slow valve closure producing column separation and cavity collapse; compare pressure traces to published gauge data.

provenance.adaptation_notes: Draft: laboratory pressure traces to be vendored after license/source confirmation of raw data.
